feedback.details: All 6 files match the required regex ^ADR-[0-9]{4}-[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\.md$. Sequential numbering 0001–0006 with no gaps or duplicates. No issues found.

Multiple ADRs fail this criterion. ADR-0005 (decisions/ADR-0005-backend-technology-stack.md:9,12,48) uses lowercase H2 headings: '## context', '## decision', '## consequences' instead of '## Context', '## Decision', '## Consequences'. These are not the required headings. ADR-0006 (decisions/ADR-0006-data-persistence-strategy.md) is missing '### Related NFRs', '### Alternatives Considered', and '### Trade-offs' subsections entirely. ADR-0003 (decisions/ADR-0003-container-diagram.md:65) has an extra H2 heading '## Diagram' — the contract states 'No additional H2 headings allowed'. 4 of 6 ADRs have section issues.

All 6 files pass mmdc validation with exit code 0. ADR-0002, ADR-0003, ADR-0004 each contain 1 valid mermaid chart. ADR-0001, ADR-0005, ADR-0006 contain no mermaid charts (no error, simply no charts to validate). Zero syntax warnings or errors across all files.

ADR-0002 (decisions/ADR-0002-system-context.md:60-75) has a valid context diagram with gardener Person/Actor node and Plant Tracking System node plus 4 external nodes — meets the ≥1 Person + ≥1 System requirement. ADR-0003 (decisions/ADR-0003-container-diagram.md:70-96) has a container diagram with subgraph grouping and multiple containers with technology annotations — meets ≥1 Container + ≥1 Database/External requirement. However, ADR-0004's diagram (decisions/ADR-0004-frontend-technology-stack.md:73-83) labels its system node as 'Frontend (Internal System)' rather than using proper C4 terminology. ADR-0001, ADR-0005, ADR-0006 have no diagrams at all, which reduces overall completeness. All edges have explicit labels.

ADR-0006 (decisions/ADR-0006-data-persistence-strategy.md) is missing the '### Related NFRs' subsection entirely — a complete omission of NFR traceability for what is fundamentally a data persistence decision. ADR-0005 (decisions/ADR-0005-backend-technology-stack.md:63) has the subsection as '### related nfrs' (lowercase) which may not be recognized programmatically as '### Related NFRs'. The NFR identifiers referenced across files (NFR-PERF-02, NFR-RELI-01, NFR-DATA-02, NFR-MAINT-01, NFR-USAB-01, NFR-DATA-03) all exist in nfr_catalog.json — no orphan references found. But the missing subsection in ADR-0006 and casing issue in ADR-0005 represent significant gaps.

ADR-0005 (decisions/ADR-0005-backend-technology-stack.md) has pervasive lowercase headings: line 9 '## context' (should be '## Context'), line 12 '## decision' (should be '## Decision'), line 25 '### alternatives considered' (should be '### Alternatives Considered'), line 31 '### trade-offs' (should be '### Trade-offs'), line 48 '## consequences' (should be '## Consequences'), line 63 '### related nfrs' (should be '### Related NFRs'). The contract requires headings follow proper case conventions and files must pass markdownlint MD001/MD022/MD023 with zero warnings. These lowercase headings would fail MD022 and MD023. ADR-0003 (decisions/ADR-0003-container-diagram.md:65) has an extra '## Diagram' H2 heading violating the 'no additional H2 headings' rule. ADR-0003 also has YAML frontmatter on lines 1-3 plus an H1 on line 5, which could cause MD022 violations (multiple H1-level headings).

ADR-0006 (decisions/ADR-0006-data-persistence-strategy.md) is missing the '### Relationships' subsection entirely under ## Status. All other 5 ADRs have '### Relationships' with 'None' as the value, which is valid per the contract's allowed phrases. No ADR references another ADR-XXXX number in Relationships, so no cross-reference validation is needed. The absence in ADR-0006 is a clear gap — a data persistence decision that clearly relates to technology stack (ADR-0001) and backend stack (ADR-0005) decisions should document those relationships.

ADR-0006 (decisions/ADR-0006-data-persistence-strategy.md) is missing both '### Alternatives Considered' and '### Trade-offs' subsections entirely — the contract requires ≥2 bullet points for alternatives and ≥1 pro + ≥1 con for trade-offs. ADR-0005 (decisions/ADR-0005-backend-technology-stack.md) has these subsections but in lowercase ('### alternatives considered' at line 25, '### trade-offs' at line 31) which may not be recognized by programmatic validation. ADR-0005's alternatives list has 4 bullet points and trade-offs section has 5 entries with pros and cons — content is present but case is wrong. ADR-0001 through ADR-0004 all have properly structured alternatives (≥2 bullets) and trade-offs with explicit pros and cons. 2 of 6 ADRs have structural failures.

overall_summary: This round's ADRs have significant structural issues. ADR-0005 suffers from systematic lowercase headings throughout (## context, ## decision, ## consequences, ### alternatives considered, ### trade-offs, ### related nfrs) that would fail markdownlint MD022/MD024 validation. ADR-0006 is the most deficient file — missing ### Relationships, ### Alternatives Considered, ### Trade-offs, and ### Related NFRs subsections entirely, effectively lacking 4 of the 6 required subsections across the document. ADR-0003 introduces an unauthorized ## Diagram H2 heading. The naming convention and mermaid syntax are clean. NFR cross-references are valid where present. The two most critical fixes are: (1) normalize all heading casing in ADR-0005, (2) add the four missing subsections to ADR-0006, and (3) remove the ## Diagram heading from ADR-0003.
